body: Incorporated upstream without creating a duplicate bead. I added decision notes to candidate-plane bd-01M15RT9Z5PTYMM8MWG39D5MAA and reservation-observability bd-01M15RTA7C28219PEVF9P6YDK5. The acceptance boundary now explicitly preserves exact-path, advisory reservations; permits binding them to a pending candidate; closes them normally on landed, abandoned, revoked, or superseded candidate state; and retains TTL or heartbeat only as recovery protection for disappeared actors. No module locks or enforced filesystem locks.
